text:
kevin: Heads-up — ACME POC hit multiple 429s during the demo just now. They run an embeddings job + interactive chat in parallel and the demo failed at 09:15 PST. Can we triage?

kevin: Example log snippet from their client:
```
[2026-03-21T09:15:12Z] req=01XHRF5A status=429 code=RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED route=/v1/generate model=redwood-rc1 tokens=1345 tenant=acme-corp headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining=0 X-Burst-Window=5s
[2026-03-21T09:15:13Z] req=01XHRF5B status=429 route=/v1/embeddings model=emb-2 tokens=256 tenant=acme-corp
```

maria: Thanks — pinging eng-platform and SRE. Do we have their tenant_id and a few request_ids? Also did they hit a per-route cap or the overall token budget?

kevin: tenant id is acme-corp. I pasted two request ids above. Customer says they sent ~60 concurrent chat streams + a batch embedding job of ~8k vectors at the same time.

sre-bot: ALERT -> tenant=acme-corp | spike in token usage 09:14-09:17 UTC | 429 rate_limit_exceeded | top routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings | current token_budget_per_min=100000 | burst_window_seconds=5

alex: Quick hypothesis: their token budget (100k/min) got exhausted by the embedding batch + chat tails. Our routing enforces per-route caps as percentages of the token budget, but bursts within a 5s window can still push remaining->0 and return 429.

alex: Can someone share the raw request headers for one of the 429s? Need X-Request-Id and X-RateLimit-* headers.

kevin: Got one from customer: X-Request-Id=01XHRF5A, X-RateLimit-Remaining=0, X-RateLimit-Limit=100000, X-Burst-Window=5

nisha: For POCs we usually do two things: 1) short-term quota bump / increase token_budget_per_min, 2) longer-term: suggest per-route hard caps to prevent embeddings from dominating chat in demos. We can also route embeddings to a cheaper quantized model variant to reduce tokens per request.

maria: Agreed. Short-term fix: admin API patch to increase token_budget and bump burst window to 10s so the embedding job doesn't consume the whole minute allocation in 5s. I can push a canary change on acme-corp tenant now.

alex: Here's the admin call I can run if approvals are set:
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://control.redwood.ai/admin/tenants/acme-corp/quotas" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"token_budget_per_min":"200000","burst_window_seconds":"10","route_caps":{"/v1/generate":"0.7","/v1/embeddings":"0.4"}}'
```

sam: Can we do this as a temporary canary for 15 minutes and watch metrics? Customer asks for an immediate unblock for the remainder of their demo (~30m).

maria: Yes — I'll approve a 30m temporary bump. Alex — please apply to tenant=acme-corp and post the change id.

alex: Applied canary -> change_id=chg_20260321_001. Token budget set to 200000/min, burst_window_seconds=10s, route_caps adjusted (generate:70%, embeddings:40%). Monitoring set for 1m granularity and alert on 95th pct token usage.

kevin: Customer confirmed demo resumed and no more 429s in the last 12 minutes. :thumbsup:

nisha: Follow-ups: 1) Sales to confirm if they want this permanent for trial tier, 2) Solutions to recommend embedding batching limits and model variant, 3) PM to consider per-tenant demo profile in Console UI (quick toggles for demo mode).

kevin: I'll log a trial-profile feature request. Also customer asked about pricing impact of the bump — can finance/sales confirm offline?

maria: We'll capture the bump usage and bill accordingly for the trial period. For future POCs we should share a suggested demo runbook (recommended concurrency, embedding batch sizes) to avoid surprises.

sam: Adding the steps we took for the postmortem:
- Confirmed tenant + request ids
- Verified 429s were token-budget exhaustion vs transient infra issue
- Applied temporary quota bump (changeld)
- Monitored metrics and validated no further 429s
- Action items: create demo runbook, add console demo toggle, consider auto-suggest route caps for new tenants

alex: I'll keep the canary active for 30 minutes, then roll back unless we get a request to make permanent. Change is logged: chg_20260321_001.

kevin: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update ACME and ask them to re-run the scale test later.

maria: Filing follow-up ticket with eng-product for the demo-profile UX + add a sample curl they can run before demos to check token headroom.

kevin: Closing this thread for now — will reopen if customer hits anything else.
